title: EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.01315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. translated_title: EP-Flow：无需位点级标注的无序晶体结构预测
translated_abstract: 生成模型在有序晶体结构预测方面取得了快速进展，然而许多功能材料本质上是无序的，其性质由替代混合、空位或间隙原子所控制。现有的晶体生成器要么假设确定性的位点占据，要么需要位点级的无序标注，而当化学式是主要输入时，这类标注往往不可获得。我们通过占据分布矩阵（Occupancy Distribution Matrix, ODM）来表述无序晶体结构预测问题，这是一种连续的位点×物种表示，能够统一有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据等各类情形。一个有效的ODM必须满足耦合的逐位点占据约束、质量守恒约束以及非负性约束，这使得每个样本都位于一个由化学式决定的运输多面体之上。我们提出了熵多面体流（Entropic Polytope Flow, EP-Flow），这是一种边际约束的流匹配框架，它对……
tldr: 提出EP-Flow框架，利用连续的占据分布矩阵（ODM）表示统一有序晶体与各类无序结构，仅凭化学式即可进行无序晶体结构预测，无需位点级无序标注。
en_tdlr: EP-Flow introduces a marginal-constrained flow matching framework built on the continuous Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), enabling disordered crystal structure prediction from chemical formulas alone without requiring site-level disorder annotations.
